visual_review: Rejected drawing's @ counter was an r2 ring that filled in as a solid blob (a spiral around a dot), and the bubble had a flat lower-left shelf; redrawn with an open r3 counter hooked into the r11 curl and a bubble whose lower-left edge sweeps smoothly into the tail as in the reference. Checked 48px light/dark.
omissions: Counter limited to r3 (r4 needs an r12 curl, which falls under 8 from the bubble); curl ends on the lower left to keep 8 from the tail.
